description: Personal notes of the kind a notes or journal app indexes: short and long, on a dozen topics, with lexical traps (python the snake, a river bank), near-empty notes, and notes in French, Spanish, German and Chinese. Grades: 3 = exactly what the query is after, 2 = substantially about it, 1 = related, 0 or absent = unrelated.

documents.text: Boston fern in the bathroom: keep the soil damp but never soggy. Mist the fronds every couple of days in winter when the heating dries the air. Brown tips mean it's too dry.
Started the tomato seedlings on the windowsill, San Marzano and Sungold. Harden them off for a week before planting out after the last frost, around mid-May.
Compost bin is too wet and smells sour. Add more browns: shredded cardboard, dry leaves. Turn it every week. Coffee grounds are fine, no meat or dairy.
Aphids all over the climbing rose again. Tried spraying with soapy water; ladybirds seem to be helping. Avoid the systemic insecticide, the bees love that rose.

Feeding schedule for the sourdough starter: equal weights of flour and water, twice a day at room temperature. It doubles in about six hours when it's healthy. Keep it in the fridge when I'm away and feed it once a week.
Red lentil soup: soften onion, carrot and garlic, add cumin and smoked paprika, one cup of lentils and five cups of stock, simmer 25 minutes, blend half, squeeze of lemon at the end.
Took the chef's knife to the market stall for sharpening, 8 dollars. He said to hold the whetstone at about 15 degrees for Japanese blades and 20 for German ones.
Dinner party Saturday for six: burrata with peaches to start, slow-roasted lamb shoulder, roast potatoes, green salad, lemon tart for dessert. Ask Priya about her nut allergy.
Lisbon, three days in April: Alfama walk and the castle on day one, Belém tower and pastéis de nata on day two, day trip to Sintra on day three. Tram 28 gets packed, go early.
Passport expires in November. Renewal takes up to ten weeks, so submit the form by early August. Need two new photos and the old passport.
Japan trip: the 7-day rail pass now costs more than individual Shinkansen tickets for our route Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka. Just buy point-to-point tickets and use a Suica card for local trains.
Packing list for the hut-to-hut hike: rain shell, two merino tops, blister plasters, headtorch, sleeping-bag liner (required in the huts), cash for the huts, earplugs.
Physio says the knee pain is patellofemoral. Exercises: wall sits, step-downs, clamshells, three sets of fifteen daily. No running downhill for a month.
Week 9 of marathon training: long run of 28 km at easy pace, two recovery runs, one tempo session of 8 km. Felt good, fuelled with a gel every 45 minutes.
Trying to fix my sleep: no screens after 10:30, same wake-up time every day even on weekends, no coffee after noon. Magnesium seems to help a little.
Blood test results back: vitamin D low (18 ng/mL), iron fine, cholesterol slightly high. Doctor suggested 2000 IU of vitamin D daily and a recheck in three months.
Q3 planning meeting: agreed to ship the offline mode before the redesign. Maya owns the sync engine, Tom the migration. Risk: the search index rebuild on old devices.
Notes for my performance review: led the offline mode launch, mentored two new engineers, cut the crash rate from 1.2% to 0.3%. Ask about the staff engineer track.
Questions to ask in the interview: how is on-call organised, how are priorities set between product and platform work, what does success look like after six months?
Standup: blocked on API keys for the payments sandbox, waiting on finance. Pairing with Tom on the migration script this afternoon.
Monthly budget: rent 1450, groceries 400, transport 120, utilities 150, savings 600. Eating out went over by 90 last month, cut back on takeaway.
For the tax return: home-office share of rent and electricity, the new laptop, professional membership fees. Keep the receipts in the green folder. Deadline 31 January.
Set up a monthly transfer of 300 into the global index fund. Low fees (0.2%), rebalance once a year, don't check it every day.
Bank appointment Thursday at 11 to talk about the mortgage. Bring payslips, the last three bank statements and ID.
Boiler losing pressure again: it drops from 1.5 bar to 0.5 overnight. The engineer thinks it's the expansion vessel. Quote: 220 for the part plus labour.
Kitchen tap drips. Turned off the isolation valve under the sink and replaced the ceramic cartridge (took the old one to the hardware shop to match it). Fixed it myself for 15.
Living room paint: shortlisted Hague Blue for the walls and a warm off-white for the ceiling. Buy sample pots, paint large swatches on two walls, check them in morning and evening light.
Book club pick for March: Klara and the Sun. Discussion questions: what does Klara understand about love, and is the ending hopeful?
Podcast recommendations from Sam: one on the history of the English language, and a long-form interview show about how scientists changed their minds.
Took Miso to the vet: booster vaccinations done, weight 4.8 kg, slight tartar on the back teeth. Next check-up in a year. Switch to the dental kibble.
Puppy training: reward recall with chicken, keep sessions to five minutes, practise 'leave it' with a treat on the floor. Stop jumping on guests by turning away.
Python project setup: python -m venv .venv, activate it, pip install -r requirements.txt. Remember to add .venv to .gitignore.
To clean up commits before a merge request: git rebase -i main, squash the fixups, then force-push with --force-with-lease, never plain --force.
Swift concurrency notes: an actor serialises access to its state; mark UI code @MainActor; Sendable checking catches data races at compile time. Avoid blocking inside an actor.
Mum's 70th birthday on 14 June: book the restaurant by the river, order the cake from the bakery on Elm Street, collect photos from everyone for an album.
School pickup rota: Monday and Wednesday me, Tuesday and Thursday Alex, Friday grandma. Swim kit on Tuesdays.
Guitar practice, thirty minutes a day: ten minutes of scales, ten of barre-chord changes (F to B flat is still slow), ten learning the fingerpicking pattern of the new song.
At the reptile house the ball python was shedding its skin. The keeper said they need a warm side around 32 °C and a cooler side, and they only eat every week or two.
Walked along the river bank at dawn. Saw a heron, two kingfishers and a family of swans. Muddy path after the rain, wear boots next time.
Apple picking at the orchard: Cox and Bramley. Bramleys for the crumble, Cox for eating. Store them wrapped in newspaper in a cool shed.

Isle of Skye, looking back on the week. We drove up from Glasgow through Glencoe, which was worth every stop even in the drizzle. Instead of the bridge we took the little ferry from Glenelg to Kylerhea: a turntable boat that carries six cars, run by volunteers, and the crossing takes five minutes over a fast tidal current. We saw seals on the way. The cottage near Portree had a wood stove and terrible wifi, which was fine. Hiking: the Old Man of Storr was crowded by ten, so go at sunrise; the Quiraing loop took three and a half hours and the wind at the top nearly knocked me over. The Fairy Pools were freezing but I swam anyway. Food highlights: langoustines at the harbour in Portree, a smoked salmon sandwich from a van by the road, and far too much tablet. Midges were bad in the evenings at the campsite in Glenbrittle, so next time bring a head net and repellent. Petrol stations are sparse in the north of the island, fill up in Portree. Overall: go in May or September, book the cottage early, and leave days free for weather.

Recette des crêpes : 250 g de farine, 4 œufs, un demi-litre de lait, une pincée de sel et un peu de beurre fondu. Laisser reposer la pâte une heure avant la cuisson.
Rendez-vous chez le dentiste mardi à 9 h pour le détartrage. Penser à apporter la carte Vitale.
Potager : semer les radis et la laitue en mars, les haricots verts en mai. Arroser le soir pour limiter l'évaporation.
Mudanza el sábado: alquilar la furgoneta a las ocho, embalar los libros en cajas pequeñas y avisar a la comunidad de vecinos para reservar el ascensor.
Las clases de inglés para los niños empiezan en octubre, los martes y jueves de cinco a seis. Hay que pagar la matrícula antes del 15 de septiembre.
Steuererklärung: Belege für Arbeitsmittel und Fahrtkosten sammeln. Abgabefrist ist der 31. Juli, mit Steuerberater später.
周末和朋友在家吃火锅：买肥牛、毛肚、豆腐、金针菇和青菜，锅底用麻辣和清汤鸳鸯锅。记得买芝麻酱做蘸料。
订机票：十月一日从上海飞成都，选早上的航班，托运行李二十公斤。提前一天在网上值机。
每天晚上跑步五公里，周末去游泳。最近膝盖有点疼，先休息一周，做拉伸。
